column1: # Korean (ko) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context: empty for ordinary labels; `preview` for text in compact rendered previews.
#   source: the exact English lookup key. Escapes: \n, \t, \\.
#   Keep every {name} placeholder and any trailing ellipsis (…).
#   Comments and blank lines are ignored; missing translations fall back to English.
# Clean room: written from the meaning of the English source, without consulting or copying
# Microsoft Word or any other product's localized UI or string tables.
# Product names, formats, command IDs and technical abbreviations keep their Latin spelling.
# Korean count labels do not vary with plural forms. UI strings do not change document content.
